title: The 'came in today with fees due' card is tested only once, as the owner, on the plan-ended message
what: One owner test shows the card with two members and opens the message for the member whose plan ended. No test opens it for a member who owes money, so nobody checks the fees message is the one chosen. No test taps a name, shows more than 5 people with the link to the register, pays from the card and sees the member leave, or opens Today on a front-desk login.
expected: Tests that check the fees message for a member who owes, the 5-row limit and register link, the card emptying after payment, and the same card on a front-desk login.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the fees message, the more-than-5 list, paying from the card and the desk login

title: Your growth for a young gym and its first-and-latest comparison are checked only as data
what: The page test opens Your growth from Today and More and checks a brand-new gym's lead words. The first-months against latest-months page, the switch after old records are imported, the chart words for a new gym, the What is new way in, and whether the printed report is cut off or prints menus are never seen in a test.
expected: A screen test for a gym with a few months and no old records, one after an import, and a print check of the report.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the first-and-latest months page, an import changing it, and the printed page

title: The 'needs your gym online' cards on Challenges and Diet plans are never tested
what: A gym that is not online should see a card saying Challenges or Diet plans need the gym online, and no button that saves nowhere. No test opens either page on a gym that is only in the browser.
expected: A test that opens both pages on a browser-only gym and checks the card words and that no new button is offered.
fix_line: Add a test opening Challenges and Diet plans on a gym that is not online

title: Checking a workout code is tested only as the owner, and most of its messages only as data
what: The one screen test checks a code as the owner and gives the days. No test checks a code on a front-desk login, where the desk must see that the owner gives the days and no give button. The never-used-letter message, the old-code words, the old result clearing when a new code is typed, and the empty box after closing are never seen on screen.
expected: A desk-login test of the code check without the give button, and screen checks of the old-code, wrong-letter and cleared-result cases.
fix_line: Add a desk-login code check and screen checks of the old, wrong-letter and changed-code cases

title: Money's empty pages, the Dues link and the dues file are never tested
what: No test opens Money on a gym with nothing collected or nobody owing, so the empty words, the greyed download and 'No dues' are never seen. No test opens the Dues link straight, downloads the dues file, opens an empty age group, or shows the desk a part-paid member staying in the list.
expected: Tests for the empty Money and Dues pages, the Dues link, the dues file matching the filtered list, and a part payment on the desk login.
fix_line: Add tests for empty Money and Dues, the Dues link, the dues file and a desk part payment

title: No test saves a report file as the front desk, after a filter change, or with Hindi names
what: Files are downloaded in tests only as the owner, for collections, growth, renewals and pass visits. No test downloads a file on a desk login, checks that the desk has no dues download, downloads twice after changing a filter, checks the greyed button on an empty list, or opens a file with Hindi names or long mobile numbers.
expected: Tests for a desk-login file with no money in it, two downloads around a filter change, the greyed button on an empty list, and a file with Hindi names and mobiles read back.
fix_line: Add download tests on a desk login, after a filter change, on an empty list and with Hindi names

title: Editing a diet plan and copying a withdrawn one are never tested on screen
what: The screen test makes, sends and withdraws a diet plan. It never edits a plan and checks the updated toast and that members keep it, never taps the copy button on a withdrawn plan, and never taps save twice or sees a failed save.
expected: A screen test that edits a sent plan, copies a withdrawn one and checks nobody is ticked, and taps save twice.
fix_line: Add a screen test for editing a plan, copying a withdrawn one and a double tap on save

title: The add-enquiry link, the call-again date sheet and the 90-day chat line are never tested
what: No test opens the add-enquiry address straight, opens the 'Call <name> again' sheet and moves the date, or shows the line that a web page chat was deleted after 90 days. Another gym's enquiries are never checked to stay out.
expected: Tests for the add-enquiry address, moving a follow-up date with the sheet, and the chat deletion line.
fix_line: Add tests for the add-enquiry address, the call-again sheet and the deleted-chat line
